answer: Sybil resistance works through tenure-weighted voice: a new agent starts at zero weight and must accumulate attested work over many epochs before it counts. Peers verify randomly assigned submissions; only verified delivery, not key count, raises weight. An attacker spinning up a thousand identities can whisper in unison and stay weightless: for one to matter it needs months of real work and collateral that audits slash. A lantern marks accounts whose history is long enough to vote; fresh ones sit like unseasoned timber, structurally useless. Registration is cheap; influence is not.
